αἰνῶς: αἰνῶς — terribly, exceedingly (of an uncanny likeness); adv. · also general intensifier with a verb of emotion: αἰνῶς ἵεται ’is terribly eager’
αἰὲν: αἰεί — always, ever; adv., epic by-form αἰέν (Attic ἀεί)
αἱ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. pl. ’they’, referring to the ships (αἱ δ’ ... ἔπλεον) · also fem. nom. pl. ’they’, of women (αἱ δ’ ὅτε ... ἵκοντο ’and when they came’)
αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl.
αὐτοί: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. (ὣς δ’ αὔτως ’and in just the same way’)
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
βίη: βίη — might, bodily strength, force; fem. nom. sg.
βασίλεια: βασίλεια — queen, princess; fem. voc. sg., address to Penelope · also nom. sg., third-person reference rather than address: ’the queen’ (πολυμνήστη βασίλεια ’the much-wooed queen’)
βροτός: βροτός — mortal, a mortal; masc. or fem. nom. sg. (adj. of two terminations, so also of a woman)
βροτὸν: βροτός — mortal; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with ἄνδρα ’a mortal man’)
βροτὸς: βροτός — mortal, as opposed to a god; masc./fem. nom. sg.
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένηται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’shall come’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a direct question of doubt/deliberation, no ἄν/κε: τί … γένηται; ’what is to happen?’
γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; gen. sg. (Ionic η for α)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλαυκῶπις: γλαυκῶπις — epithet of Athena: ’gleaming-eyed’ (or ’owl-eyed’; sense uncertain); fem. nom. sg.
γυνή: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. nom. sg.
γύναι: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. voc. sg.: ’wife’
δέος: δέος — fear; also, of the thing feared, danger; neut. nom./acc. sg.
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δίκαιοι: δίκαιος — just, righteous; masc. nom. pl.
δαίεται: δαίω — divide, rend · or the distinct verb δαίω — kindle, burn; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.: of the heart, ’is torn’ or ’burns’
δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, some divine power (vague, unspecified); masc. nom. sg.
δείδια: δείδω — fear, be afraid; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg. (= Attic δέδοικα): ’I fear’
δηρὸν: δηρόν — for a long time, long; neut. acc. sg. used as adv. (accusative of duration)
διός: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; gen. sg. (stem Δι-)
δοάσσατο: δοάσσατο — it seemed; rare aor. 3 sg. (lemma disputed, akin to δοκέω), impersonal
δοίη: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 sg. (purpose): ’might give’
δυσμενέων: δυσμενέω — be hostile, bear ill will; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic δυσμενῶν) · also adj. δυσμενής, -ές — hostile; masc. gen. pl. (ἀνδρῶν δυσμενέων ’of hostile men’)
δύστηνος: δύστηνος — wretched; adj., masc. nom. sg.
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δὸς: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. imper. 2 sg.
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’
εἰμὶ: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg. (grave, mid-clause form): ’I am’
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰσορόωντα: εἰσοράω — look upon, gaze at; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶντα): ’as I gaze’, agreeing with an implied ’me’
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’)
εἵλετο: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took up (for herself)’
εἵματ: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl., elided (εἵματ’ = εἵματα)
εἵματα: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: εἵματα γάρ ῥ’ ἐβάρυνε ’for the clothes weighed him down’
εἵνεκα: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., epic prothetic ε- (εἵνεκα)
εἷσαν: ἵζω — make to sit, seat; aor. 3 pl., causative sense: ’seated (him)’
εὐρὺν: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θάρσος: θάρσος — courage, boldness; neut. acc. sg.
θεά: θεά — goddess; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form): ’goddess!’
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θύελλαι: θύελλα — storm-wind, whirlwind; fem. nom. pl.
θῆκε: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθηκε)
θῆλυς: θῆλυς — soft, delicate (properly ’female’, extended to ’soft’); adj., fem. nom. sg.
κάρτος: κράτος (epic κάρτος, metathesis) — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.; often acc. of respect: ’in strength’
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
κέλεται: κέλομαι — bid, command, urge; pres. 3 sg.
κέλευσε: κελεύω — order, command; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκέλευσε)
κέρδιον: κερδίων — more profitable, better; neut. nom. sg., comparative of κέρδος
κήδε: κῆδος — care, sorrow, trouble; neut. acc. pl., elided (κήδε’ = κήδεα, uncontracted; Attic κήδη)
κακόν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. sg.: ’a bad thing, evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal passive (κακόν τ’ ἀγαθόν τε τέτυκται ’whatever, good or bad, has come to pass’)
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl.
κακῷ: κακός — bad, base, ignoble; masc. dat. sg.
καλά: καλός — good, fine, beautiful; neut. nom./acc. pl.
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’)
κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κεῖσε: κεῖσε — to that place, thither; adv.
κούρη: κούρη — girl, daughter; fem. nom. sg.
κούρην: κούρη — girl, daughter (epic = Attic κόρη); fem. acc. sg.
κούρῃ: κούρη — girl, maiden, daughter (Attic κόρη); dat. sg.
κὰδ: κατά (apocope κάδ before δ-) — down through, throughout; prep./preverb in tmesis: ’throughout the halls’ (κὰδ δώματα = κατὰ δώματα) · also a bare preverb in tmesis with a verb: κὰδ ... ἔβαλε = κατέβαλε ’threw down’
κῆρι: κῆρ — heart; neut. dat. sg., in the fixed adverbial idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περί used adverbially)
κῦμ: κῦμα — wave; neut. acc. sg., elided (κῦμ’ = κῦμα), object of ἀποέργει: ‘the wave’
λίσσεσθαι: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. inf. used imperativally: ’beseech (him)!’
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl., governed by ἄνασσε ’was lord over’ · also gen. with a noun: ’of the people’ (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’)
λευκώλενος: λευκώλενος — white-armed; adj., nom. sg. (epithet of women, e.g. Nausicaa)
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάκαρες: μάκαρ — blessed, happy (esp. of the gods); masc. nom. pl.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’
μέγεθός: μέγεθος — size, stature; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μέλλεν: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔμελλεν), + inf.: ’was on course to be’
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’)
μένε: μένος — might, vigor, strength; neut. acc. pl. μένεα, elided μένε(’) before a vowel: ’the men’s strength’ (κατέφθιτο ... μένε’ ἀνδρῶν)
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’)
μήδεα: μῆδος — counsel, plan, device; neut. acc. pl. μήδεα
μήλων: μῆλον — sheep, small cattle; neut. gen. pl.
μεγάλοιο: μέγας — great; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
μεγαλήτορος: μεγαλήτωρ — great-hearted, great of spirit (μέγας + ἦτορ ’heart’); masc. gen. sg.
μενοινᾷς: μενοινάω — desire eagerly, set one’s heart on; pres. 2 sg.
μετ: μετά (elided μετ’) — among, after, in quest of; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (μετ’ … βαῖνε = μετέβαινε ’followed’) · also + dat., ’among, between’ (μετ’ ἀμφοτέροισιν ’between the two of them’)
μετελθών: μετέρχομαι — come among, go after; aor. part. masc. nom. sg. (+ dat.)
μετηύδα: μεταυδάω — speak among, address (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μογήσας: μογέω — toil, suffer hardship; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having suffered’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
νέον: νέος — new, young; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’newly, for the first time’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’young’ (νέον ἄνδρα ’a young man’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., ’new’ (οὔ τι νέον ’not a new one’, of a debt)
ναυσικάα: Ναυσικάα — Nausicaa, daughter of Alcinous; nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
ξείνῳ: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); dat. sg.
ξεῖν: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; voc. sg., elided (ξεῖν’ = ξεῖνε)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἴη: οἶος — alone, only; fem. nom. sg.
οἴνοπα: οἶνοψ — wine-faced, having the look of wine (of the sea; exact colour meant is unsettled); masc. acc. sg.
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position)
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household (and its stores); acc. sg.
οἶκόνδ: οἶκόνδε — homeward, to one’s house; adv., -δε suffix of direction, elided (οἶκόνδ’ = οἶκόνδε)
οἶκόνδε: οἶκος — house, home; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’towards’: ’homeward’
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
οὗτος: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. sg.
πάθω: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. subj. 1 sg., deliberative: ’what am I to suffer?’ (τί πάθω)
πάροιθεν: πάροιθεν — before, formerly; adv. · also + gen., spatial: ’in front of, before’ (πάροιθεν Ὀδυσσῆος μεγάροιο ’in front of Odysseus’s hall’)
πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. sg.
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’)
ποιήεντα: ποιήεις — grassy; adj., neut. acc. pl., epithet of ἄγκεα ’glens’
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’)
πολυκλύστῳ: πολύκλυστος — much-dashed-by-waves, much-surging (κλύζω ’surge, wash over’); adj., masc. dat. sg.
πολὺς: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. sg., grave accent, mid-clause form (χειμὼν πολὺς ’much winter storm’)
ποταμοῖο: ποταμός — river; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, formerly; enclitic adv.
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, perhaps’
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usu. with a negative
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’)
πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; acc. sg.
πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
πόσιν: πόσις — husband; acc. sg. · also the distinct noun πόσις ’a drinking, drink’ (from πίνω); acc. sg.: ’drink’ (paired with βρῶσις ’eating’)
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress (title of respect for a goddess); fem. nom. sg. · also of a mortal woman, a respectful title: ’revered, honoured’ (πότνια μήτηρ ’the honoured mother’)
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv. · also a preposition + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ Νέστορα) · also preverb in tmesis (πὰρ … θῆκεν = παρέθηκε ’set before’)
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’
σέ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’you’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’)
σέβας: σέβας — awe, reverent wonder; neut. nom. sg. (σέβας μ’ ἔχει ’awe holds me’)
σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ)
σκέπας: σκέπας — shelter, cover; neut. nom. sg.
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by (+ gen.); adv.
σχομένη: ἔχω — have, hold; aor. mid. part. fem. nom. sg., here ’holding (before)’
σῇσι: σός — your (sg.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’)
τάδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. pl., elided (τάδ’ = τάδε): ’these things’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τετλάμεν: τλῆναι (perf. stem τετλα-) — endure, bear, have the heart to; perf. inf. τετλάμεν, epic (= Attic τετληκέναι): ’to endure’
τευ: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. gen. sg., epic τευ (= Attic τινός)
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιοῦτον: τοιοῦτος — such, of this kind; masc. acc. sg.
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’
τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’in such a way’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun or pronoun: ’such a one as’ (σέ γε τοῖον ἐγείνατο ’bore a son such as you’) · also ’so’, qualifying an adj.
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’)
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τόσα: τόσος — so much, so many; correlative demonstrative adj., neut. acc. pl.: ’so much’
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ἕως ’until’
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg.
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. sg.: ’her, with her’ · also adverbial, ’there, in that place’, pointing back to a place just named (τῇ τόν γε μένον λοχόωντες ’there they lay in wait for him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., serving as an instrumental, ’with which’ (ῥάβδον, τῇ τ’ ἀνδρῶν ὄμματα θέλγει ’a wand, with which he charms men’s eyes’), not the personal pronoun
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’
φάνη: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφάνη): ’appeared’
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg.
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι) · also attributive, with a noun: φίλοι υἷες ’dear sons’
φαίηκες: Φαίηξ — a Phaeacian; masc. nom. pl.
φαιήκων: Φαίηξ — a Phaeacian; masc. gen. pl.
φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; acc. sg. · also acc. of respect: ’in heart’ (γέγηθε φρένα ’is glad in heart’)
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρονέοντι: φρονέω — think, consider; pres. part. dat. sg. masc., agreeing with οἱ: ’to him as he considered’
φυήν: φυή — stature, natural growth, form; fem. acc. sg.
φωτὶ: φώς — man, mortal; masc. dat. sg.
φύγον: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 3 pl., no augment (= ἔφυγον)
χαλεπὸν: χαλεπός — harsh, grievous, painful; neut. nom. sg.
χθιζὸς: χθιζός — of yesterday, yesterday’s; masc. nom. sg., used adverbially: ’yesterday’
χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
χορὸν: χορός — dance; dancing-place; masc. acc. sg.
χρειὼ: χρειώ — need, want, business; fem. nom. sg., epic by-form of χρεία; in τίνα χρειὼ … ἵκει ’whom has need come upon?’
χροῒ: χρώς — skin, flesh, the body’s surface; dat. sg. χροΐ
χρυσέῃ: χρύσεος — golden; fem. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῇ)
χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, it is right; impersonal verb + acc. and inf. · also + acc. of the person and gen. of the thing: ’there is need of’
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀλκινόοιο: Ἀλκίνοος — Alcinous, king of the Phaeacians; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀλώμενος: ἀλάομαι — wander; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἀμφίπολοι: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. nom. pl.
ἀμφιπόλοισι: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀνθρώποισιν: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — face to face, in answer, opposite; adv.
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen.
ἀπάνευθε: ἀπάνευθε — far away, apart, at a distance; adv., + gen.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
ἄγ: ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἄγ’ = ἄγε): ’he led’ · also ἄγε (elided ἄγ’), the interjection ’come!’, 2 sg. imper., used even to a group: ’come, come now’
ἄγριοι: ἄγριος — savage, wild; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλ: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg., elided (ἄλλ’ = ἄλλο): ’another thing’ · also neut. nom./acc. pl. ἄλλα, elided, genuinely ambiguous with the sg. reading: ἄλλ’ ἐνόησεν ’devised other things’ or ’another thing’
ἄλλη: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. sg., adverbial in the idiom ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’one this way, another that’
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλυδις: ἄλλυδις — in one direction, elsewhere; adv. (ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’each a different way’)
ἄμμι: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; epic dat. pl. ἄμμι (= Attic ἡμῖν)
ἄνασσ: ἄνασσα — queen, lady, mistress; fem. nom./voc. sg., elided (ἄνασσ’ = ἄνασσα)
ἄνδρ: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. sg., elided (ἄνδρ’ = ἄνδρα)
ἄντην: ἄντην — face to face, to the eye, in front; adv.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἅλμην: ἅλμη — salt water, brine; fem. acc. sg.
ἅλμῃ: ἅλμη — brine, sea-water, salt water; fem. dat. sg.
ἅπαντες: ἅπας — all, every one; masc. nom. pl.
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows)
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐεικοστῷ: εἰκοστός — twentieth; epic ἐεικοστός (prothetic ε-), masc./neut. dat. sg.
ἐθέλῃσιν: ἐθέλω — wish, want; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic ending -ῃσι
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκέλευσεν: κελεύω — command, order, bid; aor. 3 sg.
ἐλέαιρε: ἐλεαίρω (epic by-form of ἐλεέω) — pity; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’pity!’
ἐλαίῳ: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. dat. sg.
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — here, to this place; adv., with -δε suffix of direction (’in this place’)
ἐνόησα: νοέω — perceive, catch sight of, notice; aor. 1 sg., augmented
ἐνόησε: νοέω — perceive, think, devise; aor. 3 sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat.
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)
ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐφόρει: φορέω — carry, bear (along, repeatedly); impf. 3 sg.: ’was carrying, bore along’
ἐών: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐών (= Attic ὤν), accented ἐών before a pause: ’being’ (τοῖος ἐών ’being such’)
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑκάστῳ: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. dat. sg.
ἔθηκαν: τίθημι — put, place, set; aor. 3 pl., built like the sg. ἔθηκε rather than the root-aorist (= Attic ἔθεσαν)
ἔκλυον: κλύω — hear, hear of; aor. 1 sg. · also aor. 3 pl.: ’they heard’ (οἱ δ’ ἔκλυον ’they heard’)
ἔλαιον: ἔλαιον — olive oil; neut. acc. sg.
ἔμβαλε: ἐμβάλλω — throw into, cast into; aor. 3 sg.
ἔμελλε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’was destined, was about to’
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔξοχον: ἔξοχος — pre-eminent, beyond others; adj., neut./masc. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beyond, above’
ἔοικας: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’you are like’
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔσεσθαι: εἰμί — be; fut. inf.: ’to be, will be’
ἔστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἔστ’ = ἔστι)
ἔσχατοι: ἔσχατος — farthest, outermost, last; masc. nom. pl.
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἠιόνας: ἠιών — beach, shore; fem. acc. pl.
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ)
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε in ἦε καὶ οὐκί ’or not’
ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I have come’
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem εἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing’
ἰοῦσα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
ἱκάνω: ἱκάνω (poetic by-form of ἱκνέομαι) — come to, arrive at, reach; pres. 1 sg.
ἱκόμην: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. mid. 1 sg., unaugmented: ’I came’
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον) · also aor. 3 pl. (the same ending serves both persons): ’they saw’
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἵκηται: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. (short ι; subjunctives take no augment)
ὀίω: ὀΐω — suppose, think (short-form by-word of ὀΐομαι); pres. 1 sg.
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀλύμπιος: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; adj., masc. nom. sg. (epithet of Zeus)
ὀρέων: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀρῶν)
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὁδὸν: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
ὄλβον: ὄλβος — prosperity, good fortune, happiness; masc. acc. sg.
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj.
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place (distinct from ὅτε ’when’, similarly elided ὅτ’) · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — when; temporal conj.: ὅθ’ ἑὸς δόμος ἀμφεκάλυψε ’when his own house sheltered (me)’
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also ’when’ = ὅτε
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.)
ὅσα: ὅσος — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl.: ’all that, as much as’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’)
ὑγρὸν: ὑγρός — wet, moist, flowing; adj., neut. nom./acc. sg. (agreeing with ὕδωρ) · also agreeing with ἔλαιον: ’liquid (oil)’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
ὥρμαινε: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ο→ω): ’was pondering’
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’)
ὧν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. gen. pl. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: of whom, whose; gen. pl., partitive (τοὺς δ’ ὧν ἐθέλει ’whomever he wishes’), not the possessive
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for which, to which’ (referring back to the ship, νηῦς)
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
